metrics.name: Total Computer Count
metrics.gotcha: CRITICAL: Dataprint root is an ARRAY. Use [0].Configuration.Computers — NOT top-level Computers (returns null). Computers[] fields include: uid, platform, computer_name, serial_number, os_version, os_version_number, has_issue (bool), missing (bool), updates_enabled (bool), agent_version, groupName (string), raw_uptime (integer seconds), minsSinceLastReport (integer).

metrics.name: Software Expirations Within 30 Days
metrics.gotcha: Expirations[].daysTillExpiration is INTEGER — use backtick-quoted integer literal. Expirations[] confirmed fields: uid, productName (string), manufacturerName (string), daysTillExpiration (integer), expires_at (Unix timestamp integer), renewable (boolean), description (string), license_key (string), groupName (string). CRITICAL: prefix [0].Configuration. required.

metrics.name: Groups Without Contact Email
metrics.gotcha: Groups[].contact_email is string or NULL. Groups[] confirmed fields: uid, name (string), slug (string), hidden (boolean), contact_email (string or null), reference_email (string or null), description (string), created_at (Unix timestamp), show_contact_menu (boolean), visible_computer_count (integer), hidden_computer_count (integer). CRITICAL: prefix [0].Configuration. required.

metrics.name: Machines with Active Issues Count
metrics.gotcha: Computers[].has_issue is BOOLEAN. CRITICAL: prefix [0].Configuration. required.

metrics.name: Missing Machines Count
metrics.gotcha: Computers[].missing is BOOLEAN. Use backtick-quoted boolean literal. CRITICAL: prefix [0].Configuration. required — top-level Computers path returns null.

metrics.name: Account Summary (Systconnfo)
metrics.gotcha: Key is 'Systconnfo' — Watchman API typo (NOT 'SystemConfig' or 'SystemInfo'). Confirmed object fields: UserCount (integer), AdminUserCount (integer), ComputerCount (integer), ExpirationCount (integer), AdminUsersStr (string), ComputersNotReportingStr (comma-separated string of not-reporting computer names). CRITICAL: prefix [0].Configuration. required.

metrics.name: Users Without 2FA Count
metrics.gotcha: Users[].tfa_status is BOOLEAN (true = 2FA enabled, false = disabled). Users[] additional confirmed fields: uid, role (string e.g. 'admin'), email, firstname, lastname, created_at (Unix timestamp), last_signin (Unix timestamp), can_access_billing (bool), can_edit_contact_menu (bool).
